easy.def: The time when the sea goes back out.

more.def: The flowing back of the tide as the sea moves away from the shore, or a time when something grows weaker.
examples: We found shells on the sand at the ebb of the tide.
The ebb and flow of the waves went on all day.
Her energy was at a low ebb after the long hike.

easy.def: To flow back out, as the sea does.

more.def: To flow back out to sea, or to slowly grow weaker.
examples: The tide ebbed, leaving shells and starfish on the sand.
The noise ebbed as the crowd went home.
The box is made of ebony.

more.def: A very hard, dark wood that is nearly black.
examples: The black piano keys were made of ebony.
The carved box was made of ebony.
Ebony is a rare, dark wood.
